name.ja: 鬼滅模型 竈門炭治郎

description.ja: ＴＶアニメ『鬼滅の刃』の主人公「竈門炭治郎」をBANDAI SPIRITS ホビー事業部の技術でプラモデル化！
description.en: The main character "Kamado Tanjiro " from the TV anime " Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba" has been made into a plastic model using the technology of BANDAI SPIRITS Hobby Division!

description.ja: ■全高約120mmの日輪刀を構えた躍動感あるポージングの無可動モデル。
description.en: • A non-movable model with a dynamic pose holding a ring sword with a total height of approximately 120mm.

description.ja: ■バンダイホビーセンターならではの「インサート成形」による顔パーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with face parts made using "insert molding" unique to Bandai Hobby Center.

description.ja: ■色再現を施した「塗装済み羽織」パーツが付属。
description.en: • "Painted haori" parts with color reproduction are included.
